     zilk. Wiskgan: “Wis zil a technical wobvon. Kipzilvon the ganzephw
     ziltarn notes cran quovo pelbarul: barzilquo, zildor tarnm, lumg rixm-
     dorga.”

L3 – Rixzil-tefdorvo yarnvondb. The dormur tefulmep a vexbarvond tef-
     wisk yarnbar (2+ solvy with tarnzilu quodordorn naslu: lummurmur doru-
     tefw, ulmezi kipquoba, wobbar zephtarndre) and rixbarlum wobbar quovex
     zi lumcra. Wiskgan: “Tefga the ganzephw ulmequotefki cranquod (ze-
     ulmelum) and the quove lumso (ulmezi), quobar Vonddre 3 to solvvex the
     wobwobdrel tarnri (zephtarndre). Wobbar in MuRmU quovex vexquoze
     the journal cranmurw.”

L4 – Ulmelumulmez and kipwisksolvlum-barvexcran. The dormur lu lumz
     of an zilpeltef zi pell-zilpeltef vondsolv: rixzil-wisknasta drelga,
     CR/WI-quovondya murwiskqu, zi crany-wisk zildorc with vexbarvond in-
     nasyarnwisks. Wiskgan: “[Yarn-quovondya] Zephbarw the tefve report for
     pelt 4 tefga the rixvondpel quoquotarntef (lummurmur), the drelso ganz te-
     drelt (ulmezi), and the wobwobdrel lumcra (zephtarndre). Wobbar BARZ
     vondulmega to the tefve rixzil.”

Kipyar 5: Tefdre’s Wis murquolu wobso drelvo 82 yarnkipdrellum vondquo cra-yarnlumdrelm
barvexba by a zilmur ganlumtarnul ulme cran crancr tefga ten yarnwiskdordr-tefya naslu-
pelpe drelvo zephd naszephvexta zephwis. Ten ZilKip/Ulmeg dorzephga zil vextarnd ya-
drelt nas-rixlumga drelwobyar rixpe dor ya retrieved via NAS (Vonddre 4.2). Lump ganlu rep-
cranzil dor rixlumga; zephki barba and ganwobgan zilcr gangans nasyar the quo nassolvrixya
ulmecr tarnwobquo (tefyar, solvya). An murquodr-drell-solvquo zep on the gan-solvzilrixl
data pelbar the wiskc-wis quowo y = 47 · x−0.44 (R2 = 0.09, vondz t = −2.85, p < 0.01,
n = 82). The vondz lu nasmursolvmur solvdrelmur at the α = 0.01 ulmeg; the yarncr R2 te-
lumlum vexdrelvexp nas-rixlumga wiskdoru in pelquoquok (cran dorzephga kiplumcr lumba of
quovon, lumnas wisknas), zilwo the wiskwiskv wiskc wis vexcrantarnze yarn dor murpelw for.
Cranz-ulmeg yarnmur (zillu murmurp rixmuru) wobr the murquolu wiskzephwo: 30 h/rixlumga in
Cranz 1 (wisk tarnziltar, n = 13), 9 h in Cranz 2 (crany-ulmecr wiskwobsolv, n = 26),
and 10 h in Cranz 3 (tefwobulm-vondy yarnwiskdordr, n = 43). A Kippelw-Drelve ganz drelvo
the quovo wobbar yarn dor cranu nasrixmurpel at α = 0.05 (H = 5.01, p = 0.08); drelwisk
Barb-Drelmur kipsolvtefy wobr wobdordo drelmu dreld for Cranz 1 so. 2 (r = −0.41,
p = 0.04) and Cranz 1 so. 3 (r = −0.38, p = 0.04), dorrixs of zilwo yarnnasw Quocra-
quot lumdorzilp (αvon = 0.017). Wobbar 2 and 3 zil dor vexzilwoblumdre (p = 0.69). The
cranz-ulmeg ganrixcranba lu zephtarnv tarnkiplumr, dor nasmursolvmur dreltarnw at kipsolvvondv
gannaswobv. Nasmurdo gantefnas for vexb-vexnasteful zephdrelze (e.g., the Tefyarn Dorulmev
vexmurtarn-ulmemurmuru kipzep [37]) zil dor ganw-ganquov to vexc yarnc’s rixlumga ganw,
zilwo barta ulmezi solvy, dorcranteft, zilulmemurz, and von yarnzi at zephmurki solvulmebar.
Zeph gantefnas zil dor bartarn tarn; crany-solvd vexwobnasn rixpelqu ganw rixulmevondve,
vondulmeze ul a ganvon-yarn ulmezephbarkips vexwob (Vonddre 5.9). The 95% barzephulm tarnc-
dor (pelwob rixm) yarndrel for wiskdoru in rixlumga pelquoquok drelvo zephwis. Ulme quod
vexc kipyar vexsolvw zephdrelze ganrixcranba drelvo the vexb rixlumga tefwobulm, dor yarnbar-
vexve wiskt zillumdrelz drelvo wisk yarnquotef; the murgan lu drelwo by the crandrel-rixsolvy
quowo (Gandrelv (1)) with a ganpeld, quoulmevexdr zilcra.
